related.title: 伊泰普水電站
related.transfer: 可遷移「徑流式電站的季節性」與「大彎河段的生態流量」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；伊泰普水電站的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Seasonality of a run-of-river plant" and "Ecological flow in the Big Bend" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Itaipu Hydroelectric Power Plant must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦引水渠截彎取直的徑流式巨型電站與 ±800 kV 遠距離送出；伊泰普水電站則以兩國兩種頻率的 14,000 MW 電站、空心重力壩與直流輸電為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on A giant run-of-river station using a canal across a river bend, with ±800 kV long-distance export; Itaipu Hydroelectric Power Plant centres on A 14,000 MW binational station with two frequencies, a hollow gravity dam and HVDC export, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「水頭、流量與出力」與「水頭、流量與出力」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「同步轉速與發電機極數」的模型移到伊泰普水電站，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「水錘與導葉關閉規律」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Head, discharge and output" and "Head, discharge and output".
Move the model of "Synchronous speed and generator poles" to Itaipu Hydroelectric Power Plant, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Water hammer and guide-vane closure", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「徑流式電站的季節性」與「大彎河段的生態流量」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；伊泰普水電站的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Seasonality of a run-of-river plant" and "Ecological flow in the Big Bend" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Itaipu Hydroelectric Power Plant must be respecified.

related.title: 古里水電站
related.transfer: 可遷移「徑流式電站的季節性」與「大彎河段的生態流量」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；古里水電站的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Seasonality of a run-of-river plant" and "Ecological flow in the Big Bend" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Guri Hydroelectric Power Plant must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦引水渠截彎取直的徑流式巨型電站與 ±800 kV 遠距離送出；古里水電站則以分期加高的重力壩、巨型水庫與單一電源過度集中的系統風險為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on A giant run-of-river station using a canal across a river bend, with ±800 kV long-distance export; Guri Hydroelectric Power Plant centres on A gravity dam raised in stages, a giant reservoir and the system risk of over-concentration in one source, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「水頭、流量與出力」與「水頭、流量與出力」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「同步轉速與發電機極數」的模型移到古里水電站，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「單一外送通道與全國停電」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Head, discharge and output" and "Head, discharge and output".
Move the model of "Synchronous speed and generator poles" to Guri Hydroelectric Power Plant, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "A single export corridor and nationwide blackout", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「徑流式電站的季節性」與「大彎河段的生態流量」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；古里水電站的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Seasonality of a run-of-river plant" and "Ecological flow in the Big Bend" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Guri Hydroelectric Power Plant must be respecified.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 美山水電站
history.text: 2011 年工程開工；2016 年首批機組投產；2017 年興古—伊斯特雷圖 ±800 kV 直流投運；2019 年18 台主機全部投產，興古—里約直流投運。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計或運轉文件。
history.textEn: 2011: Construction began. 2016: The first units entered service. 2017: The Xingu–Estreito ±800 kV link entered service. 2019: All eighteen main units were in service and the Xingu–Rio link entered operation. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design or operating documents.
